newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Clinton to visit the Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to visit the Netherlands.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will make an official visit to the Netherlands this year, a Dutch Foreign Affairs Ministry spokesman said on Saturday.
Dutch daily newspaper de Telegraaf reported that Clinton was almost certain to visit at the end of May, meeting Queen Beatrix, Prime Minister Wim Kok and European Commission President Jacques Santer.
But the spokesman said no date had been set for the visit, which may coincide with celebrations for the 50th anniversary of the Marshall Plan for Europe's post-war reconstruction.
"The date will be discussed between the office of Prime Minister Kok and the office of the U.S. president," he told Reuters.
He said it was traditional for the U.S. President and each new chairman of the European Union to meet in Europe or the United States.
The Netherlands holds the presidency of the EU for the first six months of this year.
